title: Back to Group Button
summary: ### What problem or use case is this for? Currently, if you click on an entity inside a group, your only option is to close the entity and then click on a group again. I thought I'd go through and edit the heights for all my devices, but this is quite a tedious task with grouped items. ### What would you like to see? A "Back to group" button ### Anything you've already tried or considered as a workaround? Closing the entity and clicking on the group again
